title: Así las cosas: retomar la narración tras describir una situación

sections.content: Así las cosas (that being the case, given this situation) picks the narration back up after describing a state of affairs, signaling given everything just described, here's what followed. It typically opens a new sentence. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Así las cosas, el sector manufacturero mexicano experimentó un notable auge exportador durante los años siguientes.
items.english: That being the case, Mexico's manufacturing sector experienced a notable export boom over the following years.

items.spanish: Así las cosas, hacia finales de la década, la región había firmado una gran cantidad de acuerdos comerciales superpuestos.
items.english: Given this situation, by the end of the decade, the region had signed a large number of overlapping trade agreements.

items.spanish: Así las cosas, la cooperación económica regional avanzaba en múltiples direcciones simultáneas.
items.english: That being the case, regional economic cooperation was advancing in multiple simultaneous directions.

items.spanish: Así las cosas, ningún proyecto único lograba todavía integrar de manera coherente al conjunto de la región.
items.english: Given this state of affairs, no single project yet managed to coherently integrate the region as a whole.

sections.content: Así las cosas works best right after a paragraph or sentence has laid out a complex situation -- it signals a shift from describing that situation to narrating its consequence, similar to dado este contexto but more compact.
